Kui siso vaḍi a flint ( vaḍi stone). Kuwi (F.) hīcū , (S. Su.) hiccu fire. Kur. cicc id. Malt. cicu id. / Cf. The source kīcu “fire” is a same-item, same-sense dialectal form beside previously reviewed kīccu; the full article includes that Gadaba family. Its inflection and dialect label remain in the source record.
